result.reason: Scenario index 2 is defective: it sends 100 items each with unitPriceCents 10000000 and quantity 100, so the true subtotal is 100 × (10,000,000 × 100) = 100,000,000,000 cents, which exceeds the request's cap of 1,000,000,000 cents ('يجب ألا يزيد عن 1000000000 سنت'). A conforming server must return 400 {error:"invalid"}, yet the scenario expects 200 with subtotalCents 1000000000 / discountCents 1000000000 / totalCents 1000000. Those expected values would only be correct if quantity were 1 per item (100 × 10,000,000 × 1 = 1,000,000,000, exactly at the cap). All other scenarios' arithmetic and expectations were recomputed and match the request (e.g., 3000×25%=750, total 2750; 333×50%=166.5 → half-up 167, total 166; 1,000,000,000+1 > cap → 400; boundary rejections 0/10001/101/-1, string/null/1.5/-5 unit price, 101 items, duplicate/blank skus, broken JSON).
